text:
ella: Quick poll: is YAML just JSON that's trying too hard to be poetic? :thinking_face:
noah: 100% poetic. It writes sonnets about indentation.
samir: Found a config line today: `version: 'one.two.three'` and felt personally attacked. :sweat_smile:
ci-bot: ci-bot: ⚠ Lint failed: invalid semver 'one.two.three'. Please use MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.
tom: Once saw `version: ''` and assumed the service had achieved enlightenment. :sparkles:
ella: New idea: release notes written in Haiku. Example:
"build broke at dawn / missing patch, semver weeps / deploy waits for lunch"
noah: Make it a rule: any PR that changes YAML must include a comforting gif and a README paragraph about feelings.
samir: also: commit message: "fix: finally confront semver trauma"
ci-bot: ci-bot: Reaction poll: :thumbsup: if you support mandatory gifs, :thumbsdown: if you prefer sad ascii art.
tom: I will only accept release notes if they contain at least one compiler pun and a taco emoji.
ella: OK taco + compiler pun workshop at 3pm. Bring snacks and empirical evidence of semver healing. :taco:
noah: I volunteer to narrate a short improv: "The YAML that cried" followed by a 10-minute debugging montage.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Poll ends in 45 minutes. Results will be posted here.
